title: Education Specialist / Lead Education Specialist - Maths
jobDescription:
Job Description About the

ROLE:
The Education Specialist plays a crucial role within the CARES (Comprehensive Assessment Reporting and Evaluation for Schools) team at Educational Initiatives. Working alongside content developers, software engineers, and product experts, the Education Specialist develops curriculum-aligned assessments that measure student learning and understanding across diverse school contexts. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop curriculum-aligned assessment items and test papers for Mathematics across various grade levels Create, review, and quality-check assessment content for accuracy, clarity, alignment to curriculum standards, pedagogical soundness, and to ensure assessments accurately measure conceptual understanding, application skills, and learning outcomes. Align assessment content with different curricula used by schools (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, International curricula, etc.). Analyze assessment performance data to identify learning trends, common misconceptions, and areas requiring intervention. Coordinate with the field team to understand specific assessment needs and timelines. ​Stay updated on curriculum changes, examination patterns, educational standards, and assessment best practices. Participate in cross-functional team meetings to ensure seamless product development and delivery. Contribute to continuous improvement of the CARES assessment platform. Manage small projects & meet deadlines . Requirements Must Have : Strong subject knowledge in Mathematics across middle and high school levels. Strong attention to detail and quality focus. Ability to manage tight timelines and work under pressure. Good to Have : Proficiency in data analytics Microsoft office suite Not Suitable for : Significant/ frequent job hoppers Individuals who do not like daily deadlines. Knowledge, Experience and

QUALIFICATIONS:

title: Strategic Account Manager (Bengaluru)
jobDescription:
Job Description Role Purpose The Strategic Accounts Manager is responsible for owning and growing relationships with India's leading school groups and strategic institutions. It combines business development, account expansion, customer success, market creation, and strategic partnership management to drive sustainable revenue growth while ensuring measurable customer outcomes. Key Responsibilities
1. Revenue Growth • Acquire new strategic school groups and institutional partnerships. • Develop annual account growth plans for every assigned group. • Drive new business from existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling Ei's portfolio. • Identify expansion opportunities across all schools within a group.
2. Strategic Account Management • Build trusted relationships with Chairpersons, Trustees, CEOs, Directors, Academic Heads, and Principals. • Become the single strategic partner for assigned school groups. • Conduct quarterly business reviews with leadership teams. • Develop multi-year partnership roadmaps. • Ensure seamless implementation across all products. • Monitor customer health and proactively address risks.
4. Collections & Commercial Ownership • Own commercial closure from proposal to payment. • Ensure timely collections and contract renewals. • Improve revenue realization and cash flow.
5. Market Creation • Build Ei's visibility within school groups, associations, and educational networks. • Create demand through workshops, leadership forums, webinars, and thought leadership. • Develop advocates and champions within school ecosystems. • Generate referrals and expand influence across group schools.
6. AI & Research-Led Selling • Leverage AI tools to improve prospecting, account planning, proposal creation, and customer engagement. • Use educational research and learning outcome data to build consultative sales conversations. • Stay updated on AI trends, school transformation, competency-based education, and assessment practices. • Bring data-driven insights that help customers improve learning outcomes.
8. Voice of Customer • Gather customer feedback. • Influence product roadmap. • Identify emerging market needs. • Recommend new solutions for strategic customers. Requirements Preferred Skills Strategic Account Management Enterprise/B2B Sales Relationship Management Consultative Selling Business Planning Data Analysis Presentation Skills AI-enabled Productivity CRM Management Market Research Educational Consulting Qualification & Experience • Graduate/Post Graduate/MBA • 5–10 years of experience in Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Consulting, or Business Development • Experience in Education, Ed Tech, or B2B solutions is preferred • Proven track record of managing large strategic accounts and delivering revenue growth The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who: • Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson. • Builds partnerships, not transactions. • Uses research and data to influence customer decisions. • Embraces AI to work smarter and faster. • Balances commercial success with educational impact. • Thrives in ambiguity and takes complete ownership of outcomes. title: Head of Growth – Corporate Relations | Ei Shiksha
jobDescription: Job Description About the role As Head of Growth: Corporate Relations, you will own Ei Shiksha’s CSR and Corporate foundation revenue line and lead the strategy, execution, and team management required to grow it. You will report to the Head of Ei Shiksha and manage a team of professionals focussed on enhancing revenue from these segments across India. Corporate sponsors are expected to contribute 60%+ of Ei Shiksha’s future growth and sustainability. Your role will therefore be central to expanding both our impact and revenue. Key Areas of Focus ● 40% – Fundraising & Revenue Growth: Lead major sponsor conversations, build strategic pipelines, and close multi-year partnerships. ● 20% – Strategic Partnerships: Develop collaborations and consortiums that unlock large-scale implementation and funding opportunities. ● 20% – Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and enable a high-performing team focussed on revenue growth from CSR and Corporate Foundations. ● 10% – Growth Strategy: Shape funding priorities, identify emerging opportunities, and maintain a forward-looking pipeline. ● 10% – Systems & Representation: Strengthen fundraising systems, sponsor stewardship, and represent Ei at sector forums and conferences. What you will do In this role, you will build and manage a portfolio of India’s most strategic CSR sponsors and Corporate foundations aligned to Ei Shiksha’s mission. You will lead or oversee the full fundraising lifecycle, from prospecting and outreach to pitching, proposal development, budgeting, negotiation, closure, legal documentation, and onboarding. You will sit across the table from CSR leaders and Corporate foundation decision-makers, understand their business and social impact priorities, and translate Ei Shiksha’s work into a compelling case for partnership. A key part of the job will be developing multi-year, multi-crore commitments rather than one-time grants. You will work closely with internal program, finance, and leadership teams to build customized proposals and partnership models for prospects. You will also contribute to ambitious strategic collaborations that can help Ei Shiksha scale faster and deepen its impact in public education. Team leadership and growth A major part of this role is building the team around you. You will set clear expectations, define ownership, and create systems that support stronger execution and better planning. You will coach team members to independently manage mid-sized relationships and close meaningful deals. You will also help develop the next layer of leadership within the team, ensuring that the function is not only productive today but scalable for the future. This role requires someone who can balance high standards with empathy, and performance management with respect and clarity. What success looks like ● Sustained year-on-year growth in the corporate sponsor/funder base. ● Strong and predictable revenue/fundraising performance, with high-quality long-term partnerships. ● A team that can independently manage a substantial share of the portfolio. ● Strategic collaborations that strengthen Ei Shiksha’s scale and sustainability. ● A stronger external presence for Ei as a credible thought partner in the education and impact ecosystem. Requirements Essential Experience ● 15+ years of experience in fundraising, business development, enterprise sales, or strategic partnerships. ● Demonstrated success in raising ₹10 crore+ annually through CSR and corporate foundation partnerships or similar. ● Experience managing high-value sponsor portfolios with average deal sizes of ₹80 lakh or more. ● Proven leadership experience managing teams of five or more people. Capabilities ● Ability to quickly establish credibility with senior corporate and their foundation stakeholders. ● Strong proposal writing, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills. ● Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex educational challenges into compelling funding opportunities. ● Comfortable representing the organization in high-profile external forums. Personal Attributes ● Strong commitment to educational equity and social impact. ● High integrity and intellectual honesty. ● Resilience and persistence in navigating long fundraising cycles. ● Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in evolving environments. ● Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills. Preferred ● Existing relationships with CSR leaders and corporate foundations. ● Familiarity with education, Ed Tech, or learning-outcomes-focused organizations. ● Experience contributing to sector thought leadership through speaking, writing, or public engagement. ● Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. This Role May Not Be Right If ● You are more comfortable delivering programs than building partnerships and raising funds. ● You prefer working within a narrow sponsor/donor category rather than developing a diversified portfolio. ● You require highly structured environments and are uncomfortable creating new systems. ● You are unwilling to travel regularly. Compensation & Logistics ● Competitive compensation aligned with senior leadership roles in the education and social impact sector. We are open to discussing the range based on experience. ● Location: Bengaluru. ● Travel: Approximately 30–40% across India. ● Expected joining: Within 1–2 months of offer. What you will do In this role, you will build and manage a portfolio of India’s most strategic CSR sponsors and Corporate foundations aligned to Ei Shiksha’s mission. You will lead or oversee the full fundraising lifecycle, from prospecting and outreach to pitching, proposal development, budgeting, negotiation, closure, legal documentation, and onboarding. You will sit across the table from CSR leaders and Corporate foundation decision-makers, understand their business and social impact priorities, and translate Ei Shiksha’s work into a compelling case for partnership. A key part of the job will be developing multi-year, multi-crore commitments rather than one-time grants. You will work closely with internal program, finance, and leadership teams to build customized proposals and partnership models for prospects. You will also contribute to ambitious strategic collaborations that can help Ei Shiksha scale faster and deepen its impact in public education. Team leadership and growth A major part of this role is building the team around you. You will set clear expectations, define ownership, and create systems that support stronger execution and better planning. You will coach team members to independently manage mid-sized relationships and close meaningful deals. You will also help develop the next layer of leadership within the team, ensuring that the function is not only productive today but scalable for the future. This role requires someone who can balance high standards with empathy, and performance management with respect and clarity. What success looks like ● Sustained year-on-year growth in the corporate sponsor/funder base. ● Strong and predictable revenue/fundraising performance, with high-quality long-term partnerships. ● A team that can independently manage a substantial share of the portfolio. ● Strategic collaborations that strengthen Ei Shiksha’s scale and sustainability. ● A stronger external presence for Ei as a credible thought partner in the education and impact ecosystem. Requirements Essential Experience ● 15+ years of experience in fundraising, business development, enterprise sales, or strategic partnerships. ● Demonstrated success in raising ₹10 crore+ annually through CSR and corporate foundation partnerships or similar. ● Experience managing high-value sponsor portfolios with average deal sizes of ₹80 lakh or more. ● Proven leadership experience managing teams of five or more people. Capabilities ● Ability to quickly establish credibility with senior corporate and their foundation stakeholders. ● Strong proposal writing, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills. ● Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex educational challenges into compelling funding opportunities. ● Comfortable representing the organization in high-profile external forums. Personal Attributes ● Strong commitment to educational equity and social impact. ● High integrity and intellectual honesty. ● Resilience and persistence in navigating long fundraising cycles. ● Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in evolving environments. ● Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills. Preferred ● Existing relationships with CSR leaders and corporate foundations. ● Familiarity with education, Ed Tech, or learning-outcomes-focused organizations. ● Experience contributing to sector thought leadership through speaking, writing, or public engagement. ● Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. This Role May Not Be Right If ● You are more comfortable delivering programs than building partnerships and raising funds. ● You prefer working within a narrow sponsor/donor category rather than developing a diversified portfolio. ● You require highly structured environments and are uncomfortable creating new systems. ● You are unwilling to travel regularly. Compensation & Logistics ● Competitive compensation aligned with senior leadership roles in the education and social impact sector. We are open to discussing the range based on experience. ● Location: Bengaluru. ● Travel: Approximately 30–40% across India. ● Expected joining: Within 1–2 months of offer. title: Software Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Position Accountability
1. Deliver on the strategic roadmap for enterprise-grade products.
2. Contribute to a strong engineering culture through modern technology adoption and technical design.
3. Work with cross-functional teams (Usability, Product Management, Operations) to design end-to-end solutions.
4. Imbibe Agile values and actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies. Job Description
1. Design, develop, and deploy scalable application components and microservices.
2. Leverage AI tools and LLMs for code generation, automated debugging, and optimizing daily development workflows.
3. Adhere to DOD (story definition of done) as part of the sprint, including unit tests, functional testing, code reviews, no regressions, bug fixes, documentation and adhere to best coding practices.
4. Deliver high-quality software in adherence with security, longevity, and integration testing policies.
5. Master the domain knowledge in the area of assignment.
6. Take ownership of features post release; considering customer adoption as a primary success metric.
7. Volunteer for work in the backlog and commit to quality delivery; Coordinate efforts across the team to ensure completion and effectiveness.
8. Participate and contribute to scrum meetings i.e. daily stand-up, sprint planning, readouts and retrospectives.
9. Work collaboratively across the Technology and Product organizations to ensure alignment towards business goals. Technical Experience
1. Strong knowledge and experience in Object Oriented Programming, Analysis and Design concepts.
2. Proficiency in Node.js and RESTful Microservices.
3. Hands-on experience with Angular or React.js, including Type Script, CSS, and state management.
4. Working experience in SQL databases (e.g. My SQL, Postgre SQL)
5. Very comfortable using GIT version control tool (we use Bitbucket) and familiarity with AI-assisted coding assistants. Academic and Professional Expertise
1. Holds an academic degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Computational Science.
2. 1 to 2 years of working experience as full stack engineer
3. Ambitious individual who can work under their own direction towards agreed targets/goals.
4. Experience in working in Agile scrum teams.
5. Ability to handle change and be open to it along with good time management and an able to work under stress
6. Respond to technical queries / requests from team members and customers
7. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
8. Ability to work with minimal direction with a focus on customer satisfaction
9. Creative problem-solving skills and superb communication skills. title: Educational Specialist - Science
jobDescription:
Job Description About the Role The Education Specialist plays a crucial role within the CARES (Comprehensive Assessment Reporting and Evaluation for Schools) team at Educational Initiatives. Working alongside content developers, software engineers, and product experts, the Education Specialist develops curriculum-aligned assessments that measure student learning and understanding across diverse school contexts. Key Responsibilities
1. Develop curriculum-aligned assessment items and test papers for Science across various grade levels
2. Create, review, and quality-check assessment content for accuracy, clarity, alignment to curriculum standards, pedagogical soundness, and to ensure assessments accurately measure conceptual understanding, application skills, and learning outcomes.
3. Align assessment content with different curricula used by schools (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, International curricula, etc.).
4. Analyze assessment performance data to identify learning trends, common misconceptions, and areas requiring intervention.
5. Coordinate with the field team to understand specific assessment needs and timelines.
6. Stay updated on curriculum changes, examination patterns, educational standards, and assessment best practices.
7. Participate in cross-functional team meetings to ensure seamless product development and delivery.
8. Contribute to continuous improvement of the CARES assessment platform.
9. Manage small projects & meet deadlines. Requirements Must Have (one or two absolutely non negotiable skills) • Strong subject knowledge in Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) across middle and high school levels. • Strong attention to detail and quality focus. • Ability to manage tight timelines and work under pressure. Good to Have (Any one of two skills which will be good to have) • Proficiency in data analytics • Microsoft office suite Not Suitable For (Any one of two things which will not work for the role/ Ei) • Significant/ frequent job hoppers • Individuals who do not like daily deadlines. Knowledge, Experience & Qualification • Masters degree in Physics/Chemistry • 0-2 years experience in education, Assessments or educational research I'm interested View all jobs Visit website Home Powered by {{criteria Index}} {{field}} {{captialize(condition)}} ( ) {{cx Prop Help Text}} {{cx Prop Field.consent_details.description}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{candidate.Email}} {{top Message}} Job Details {{top Message}} previous next {{title}} {{score}}% Job Description {{unescape(sanitize HTML(description HTML))}} {{message}} Step {{cur Step In Mandatory Sec Prompt}}/{{total Num Of Steps In Mandatory Sec Prompt}} For privacy and security purposes, please go through the following points and provide consent. title: Lead Education Specialist, Tripura PMU
jobDescription:
Job Description
1. Academic Leadership & Content Alignment • Ensure training quality and content relevance through regular reviews and planning cycles. • Facilitate contextualisation of training materials and assessments for Tripura's state context. • Support in validation of academic documents — frameworks, blueprints, and question papers. • Collect, analyse, and act on feedback from field stakeholders and teacher participants.
2. Project Coordination & Implementation • Lead implementation of training and assessment events in collaboration with state counterparts. • Plan and track academic deliverables in coordination with cross-functional internal teams. • Coordinate field visits, data collection, and documentation efforts. • Contribute to weekly/monthly reports and project reviews.
3. Stakeholder Engagement • Serve as the primary point of contact between Ei and government officials in Tripura. • Conduct regular check-ins and co-planning sessions with internal and external stakeholders. • Present program updates and findings to government officials and key partners. Requirements Qualifications and Experience
1. Master’s degree in Education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or related fields.
2. 2–5 years of work experience in education project implementation, content development, or teacher training.
3. Prior experience working with government school systems is preferred. title: Lead Educational Specialist - Science (Assessments)
jobDescription:
Job Description
1. Content Development • Contribute as a key member in the design, implementation, administration, evaluation, and revision of Science assessments (Pre-K to Grade 12). • Create, review, and facilitate high-quality assessment tools for Science projects. • Ensure content is pedagogically sound, learner-centric, innovative, and aligned to learning outcomes. • Develop remedial content based on low-performance questions and identified learning gaps. • Review Science questions and recommend revisions to enhance conceptual clarity, rigor, and quality. • Collaborate with internal and freelance team members to ensure timely and highquality delivery of project outputs. • Maintain comprehensive and organized documentation for all deliverables. • Travel to field locations to evaluate the implementation and effectiveness of assessment tools.
2. Academic & Analytical Support • Support and/or conduct data analysis to measure student performance and identify learning trends. • Assist in designing and conducting training sessions and workshops on assessment processes, question design, result interpretation, and reporting.
3. Organizational Development • Expand project impact through high-quality dissemination, including blogs, journal articles, working papers, and other publications. • Conduct ongoing research related to assessments and content to strengthen the team’s knowledge base. • Support team growth by building capacity in pedagogy, assessment design, and related academic areas.
